content:
# Auckland and Hobbiton Travel Memories

## Sierra Café
In Auckland, we first went to Sierra Café for brunch. I ordered French toast. I thought it was extremely delicious because the sweetness of condensed milk blended into the cake very well.

## Albert Park
After brunch, we walked to Albert Park in Auckland. Four of us took a group photo in front of the fountain, and everyone looked very happy.

## Mount Victoria / Takarunga
We walked a long distance from the city to the harbour and took a ferry to the Devonport area to visit Mount Victoria / Takarunga. It is known as a good place for sunset views, but we were already tired and only wanted to briefly enjoy the view before going back to the hotel. The climb was tiring. We also took a steep shortcut, but during the climb my friend's phone screen was accidentally damaged. We decided that next time we should not choose such risky shortcuts. When we finally reached the top, Auckland city could be seen clearly. I opened my arms and took a photo with the whole city view.

## Hobbiton Movie Set
We woke up very early and took a three-hour ride to Hobbiton Movie Set. A guide led us through the movie set and explained the connection between the Hobbit films and the filming location. I took a photo with one of the small Hobbit houses, and I thought the houses were very cute. We also visited the inside of one Hobbit house, where a children's bunk bed looked especially cute. At the end of the visit, I drank ginger beer from a cute brown cup.

## Feijoa and Auckland Indian Dinner
On the way back to Auckland city, the driver found wild New Zealand feijoa fruit by the roadside and picked some for us to try. The taste was sour and sweet. At night, we ate Indian food in Auckland city. The butter chicken curry with garlic naan was extremely delicious.

# Christchurch Travel Memories

## Dinner at Amazonita and Night Walk
We arrived in Christchurch at night and looked for dinner first. On the way, we saw an arch-like landmark in the city at night, which gave me a local feeling. We had dinner at a western restaurant called Amazonita in the city centre. Four of us ordered cream beef pasta, spicy shrimp pasta, small squid, and small crispy balls. Every dish tasted very good. After dinner, we walked slowly back to the hotel in the cool wind, and it felt very relaxing.

## Unknown Chapter Brunch
The next day, we chose a highly rated brunch restaurant in Christchurch called Unknown Chapter Coffee Roasters. I ordered avocado toast. The taste was good. Four of us ordered different dishes and tried each other's food. In the end, I still thought my avocado toast was the best.

## Christchurch City Walk
After brunch, we walked around Christchurch city. At Victoria Square, I felt a bit tired. My two good friends tried to lift me up, and I was really lifted. All three of us laughed, and they joked that I was heavy. I also noticed many Christchurch trams. We saw a famous landmark that looked like a floating or suspended house.

## Christchurch Botanic Gardens and Airport
Finally, we walked to Christchurch Botanic Gardens. There was a very beautiful fountain at the entrance, and I took a lively photo with it. I felt very happy and really liked the photo. In the gardens, I also photographed falling leaves, which made me feel that autumn had really arrived. While waiting at Christchurch Airport, I noticed that the toilet signs respected gender diversity, showing male, female, and all-gender access.

# Queenstown, Milford Sound, Mount Cook and Lake Tekapo Travel Memories

## Queenstown Lakefront and Skyline
In Queenstown, we first ate a highly rated taco near the lake. It was juicy and tasted very good. Then we took the Skyline Queenstown Gondola to a high viewpoint overlooking Queenstown. I took a photo with my good friend inside the gondola. From the top, the landscape looked wide and beautiful, with the lake and mountains below.

## Skyline Luge and Dinner
At the top of Skyline Queenstown, we played luge. It felt a little exciting. While queueing for the luge, my down jacket was accidentally torn. I used two bandages to cover the hole in a cross shape, and it looked surprisingly unique. That night in Queenstown, I ate cream pasta with many basil leaves. I really liked the texture.

## Milford Sound and Fiordland National Park
Milford Sound was still a distance from Queenstown. We left in the morning and took about four hours to arrive. On the way, we stopped at Fiordland National Park and took photos with the mountains behind us. At Milford Sound, we took a boat and experienced the beauty of the fjord landscape closely.

## Fergburger
When we returned to Queenstown at night, we ate the famous Fergburger and also had donuts from the same place. Both were extremely delicious, but I forgot to take photos of the food and only took a photo of the Fergburger sign.

## Aoraki / Mount Cook and Lake Tekapo
On the bus from Queenstown to Christchurch, we first passed Aoraki / Mount Cook. In April, the mountain peak already had snow. I heard the glacier walk there is famous, but we did not have enough time. After a meal at Mount Cook, we continued the trip. The cream mushroom soup there was good. Later we passed the Church of the Good Shepherd at Lake Tekapo. The lake reflection looked even bluer than the sky. I took a photo there that I really liked because I was smiling brightly.

# Travel Preferences

I prefer scenic outdoor places, beaches, riverside walks, lake views, mountain views, city viewpoints, and iconic landmarks. I like places suitable for photography and walking. I also enjoy memorable food experiences, especially brunch, pasta, curry, and local specialties.

I prefer travel activities that feel relaxing, beautiful, and meaningful. I like travelling with friends and keeping funny or emotional memories. I do not like overly risky shortcuts or activities that may cause accidents. I can enjoy exciting activities such as luge, but I prefer them to be safe.
